blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Будь внимателен, когда ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) подсолнечное масло.
exercises.why: **несёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Be careful when carrying sunflower oil.

exercises.q: Маюко ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) цветочный венок.
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Кто ___ (возить — to convey by vehicle, there and back or in general) детей в школу?
exercises.why: **возит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of возить: many-directions verb (one direction: везти).
exercises.prompt: Who's taking the kids to school?

exercises.q: Рыцари ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) сложные доспехи.
exercises.why: **носили** — past tense (plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: The knights wore elaborate suits of armor.

exercises.q: Древние греки часто ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) туники.
exercises.why: **носили** — past tense (plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).
exercises.prompt: The ancient Greeks often wore tunics.

exercises.q: Скифы ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general) остроконечные колпаки.
exercises.why: **носили** — past tense (plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Простите, я немного пьян, так что я могу ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) околесицу.
exercises.why: **нести** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: Sorry, I'm a bit drunk, so I may be saying ridiculous things.

exercises.q: Оленя можно приучить ___ (возить — to convey by vehicle, there and back or in general) сани.
exercises.why: **возить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: везти).
exercises.prompt: Reindeer can be trained to pull sleds.

exercises.q: Критик — это курица, которая кудахчет, пока остальные ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) яйца.
exercises.why: **несут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: A critic is a hen that clucks while others are laying.

exercises.q: Мне снился дивный сон когда-то: семь грузчиков ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) мою зарплату.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: I once had a wonderful dream: seven porters were carrying my salary.

exercises.q: У Тома было много мыслей, поэтому он невнимательно ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way) машину.
exercises.why: **вел** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
exercises.prompt: Tom had a lot on his mind, so he wasn't paying enough attention to his driving.

exercises.q: Я вчера ___ (возить — to convey by vehicle, there and back or in general) кота в ветеринарную клинику.
exercises.why: **возил** — past tense (masculine) of возить: many-directions verb (one direction: везти).
exercises.prompt: I took my cat to the veterinary hospital yesterday.

exercises.q: Ты не ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general) в нетрезвом состоянии, не так ли?
exercises.why: **водишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).
exercises.prompt: You're not drinking and driving, are you?

exercises.q: Девочка ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) несколько книг — не учебников, а толстых книг в твёрдом переплёте.
exercises.why: **несла** — past tense (feminine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
exercises.prompt: The girl was carrying several books, not textbooks but thick hardback books.

exercises.q: Старая деревенская телега, влекомая волами, громыхала по пыльной дороге – крестьяне ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way) урожай на рынок.
exercises.why: **везли** — past tense (plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
exercises.prompt: The old village cart was ox‑drawn, clattering along the dusty road as the farmers hauled their harvest to market.

exercises.q: ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way) к дому!
exercises.why: **неси** — imperative (ты, singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Что ты ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)?
exercises.why: **несешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Не дам ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)!
exercises.why: **нести** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way), что ль!
exercises.why: **несите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Ну и ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way).
exercises.why: **ведите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
